0022600025.text: The Atlanta Hawks (5-4, first in the Southeast and fifth in the East) host the Washington Wizards (4-4, eighth in the East and 0.5 games behind Atlanta in the Southeast) in this Emirates NBA Cup East Group C regular-season game, Atlanta's 10th of the season. The Hawks have won their last two and are 1-2 at home and 4-2 on the road, while Washington is 2-2 at home and 2-2 on the road after a loss in its last game. Atlanta leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after its 120-105 win in Washington, and it won the 2025-26 series 3-1. Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee), Jalen Johnson (ankle), Jock Landale (hip) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), and Asa Newell (toe) is day-to-day and a game-time decision, while Washington is without Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve).
